sampling: Nearest actual native PTS at nominal 25 Hz; duplicate frame UIDs removed
coordinates: native 1920x1080 pixels; no model centroids prefilled
reviewers: Two independently completed worksheets with reviewer identity, visibility and agreement adjudication required
contact: Relations alone insufficient: independently traced boundary geometry and hashes required
identity: Review full context, do not assume provisional annotation-chain IDs
limits: Development participants already exposed; this pack cannot establish fresh final acceptance
rgb: References existing uncompressed native shards; no RGB copies or compression
target_definition: Class cue is a source label only. Each reviewer must independently identify the entity and define the same visible physical landmark; flag ambiguity/occlusion instead of copying a source centroid. Adjudicate landmark definitions before derivative scoring.
